checkpointPayload.description:
Sega's maimai-mobile servers (maimaidx-eng.com, maimaidx.jp) are down (confirmed timeouts 2026-10-29/30), so every jacket in web + mobile is broken. Both apps hotlink `https://maimaidx-eng.com/maimai-mobile/img/Music/{image_url}`.

Findings (probed 2026-10-29):
- otoge-db GitHub mirror `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zvuc/otoge-db/master/maimai/jacket/{image_url}` — keyed by the SAME image_url we store, 20/20 sampled hit (incl. 5 newest), 190x190 PNG, CORS *. Already used by web `getJacketUrl` for JP-only songs.
- Other live mirrors need ID mapping: LXNS `assets2.lxns.net/maimai/jacket/{musicId}.png`, diving-fish `/covers/{id:05}.png`, DXRating `shama.dxrating.net/images/cover/v2/{dxdata imageName}.jpg`.
- Reference: tomomai caches jackets to its own R2 (apps/main/src/app/api/admin/image/route.ts) — long-term option, out of scope here.

Call sites: web `apps/web/lib/song-db.ts` getJacketUrl (Jacket component, SongDetailsModal, scores-client, matrix-view, songs-client, chart-detail-drawer); web `apps/web/lib/b50-image.ts` fetchJacket (server-side, Sega + cookie, 8s timeout); mobile: 9 hardcoded Image sources in index.tsx, scores.tsx, modal.tsx, songs.tsx, sessions.tsx.
checkpointPayload.title: Jacket image fallback chain (Sega outage)

taskChanges.newValue: Source order: [otoge-db GitHub mirror, Sega official, placeholder]. Mirror first because Sega currently times out (browser waits long before onError) and the mirror is keyed by the same image_url. Sega stays as secondary. 1. Web helper (apps/web/lib/song-db.ts): add `getJacketUrls(imageName, intl): string[]` returning the ordered list; `getJacketUrl` returns [0] so existing callers keep working (CSS backgroundImage in scores-client stays single-URL). 2. Web component: `apps/web/components/jacket-img.tsx` ('use client') — that steps through getJacketUrls on onError, then renders placeholder. Use it in Jacket, SongDetailsModal, songs-client, chart-detail-drawer, matrix-view. 3. Debug page first (AGENTS.md rule): add a "Jacket fallback" section to /debug/song-details showing a few real songs with each source + a forced-Sega-fail case. Verify, then wiring reaches tracker via Jacket. 4. B50 server render (apps/web/lib/b50-image.ts fetchJacket): try mirror (no cookie, 8s timeout), then Sega with cookie; disk/mem cache unchanged; don't cache a null from a timeout permanently. 5. Mobile: `apps/mobile/components/JacketImage.tsx` (RN Image, onError advances index), same order; replace the 9 hardcoded `maimaidx-eng.com` sources. 6. Verify: web tsc + lint, load /debug/song-details and /tracker, curl-check mirror; mobile tsc. Out of scope (follow-ups): tertiary mirror (LXNS/DXRating needs title->id mapping), self-hosted R2 cache like tomomai.
